moments.title: Summer Bank Holiday in Scotland
moments.blurb: Today marks the Summer Bank Holiday in Scotland, a chance for many to enjoy a long weekend.

angles.name: Enjoying the day off
angles.copy: Happy Bank Holiday, Scotland! What are your plans for this bonus Monday off? Sunshine or staying cosy? #Scotland

angles.name: Weekend vibes extended
angles.copy: While some of us are back at it, our friends in Scotland are enjoying a Summer Bank Holiday today! Who wishes they were up there?

moments.title: The Hundred Cricket Tournament Continues
moments.blurb: The Hundred 2026 cricket tournament is in full swing across the UK, with matches happening almost daily this week, including Welsh Fire playing Southern Brave in Cardiff today.

angles.name: Today's big match
angles.copy: It's match day for Welsh Fire! They take on Southern Brave in The Hundred today. Who's heading to Sophia Gardens to cheer them on?

angles.name: Cricket fever
angles.copy: The Hundred is bringing the big hits and fast action this week! Catch matches across the country, with games from Cardiff to Leeds. Are you following your team?

angles.name: Devon's interest in The Hundred
angles.copy: Southern Brave are in action today in The Hundred! Are any Devon cricket fans tuning in or heading to support the team?

angles.name: Happy Birthday, James Hetfield

angles.name: Metal icon
angles.copy: 63 today for the voice of a generation! James Hetfield, rock on. We're playing a classic to celebrate on Nation Rocks.

moments.title: Roots Picnic makes international debut in London
moments.blurb: The iconic Roots Picnic festival is making its international debut at Crystal Palace Bowl, London, this weekend (August 8-9), blending hip hop, music, and culture.

angles.name: London's new festival
angles.copy: Roots Picnic is HERE! The legendary festival makes its international debut in Crystal Palace this weekend. Who's got tickets for the hottest hip hop and R&B?

angles.name: Weekend festival buzz
angles.copy: Big weekend in London for music lovers! The first-ever international Roots Picnic kicks off on Saturday. Expect huge acts and an incredible vibe.

moments.title: Nigella Lawson joins Great British Bake Off
